palette.method: Procedural fills/text receive exact token RGB; body/edge opacity, AA and board pixels excluded. Accepted target PNG reused as-is; no recolouring. This is construction proof, not a palette test of the painted background.

gray.method: Exact Rec.709 partners of every generated sheet/frame; digit shape pairs; state pixel difference >=20 luma

outside_folder_audit.method: Full path/size/mtime_ns before/after inventory. Concurrent external changes retained here separately; outside_folder lists this build's out-of-scope writes (scoped output registry + explicit metadata destinations). Initial manual commands wrote only in PKG. .git/unreal never opened.

damage capsule >= 4.5:1.note: WCAG actual composited panel under glyph core

the plate crosses no reachable space (0.note: Hover none; own Medusa topology move3 unoccupied endpoints; Arthur inspect none; attack Medusa/Merlin spaces

marmoreal.method: bilinear homography; 0.48px softening; robust linear RGB ring fit; first brightness mask; second compact light-stroke pass and full-opacity glyph core; feather outside core; harmonic diffusion outside illustration

visual_review.note: Before/after/mask PNG opened directly. No readable old name or HP text in after column; frame band has no readable Harpies 3. Board connections and rims remain continuous; dark-figure zero-change proof is numeric.

sarpedon.method: bilinear homography; 0.48px softening; robust linear RGB ring fit; first brightness mask; second compact light-stroke pass and full-opacity glyph core; feather outside core; harmonic diffusion outside illustration

visual_review.note: Before/after/mask PNG opened directly. No readable old name or HP text in after column; frame band has no readable Harpies 3. Board connections and rims remain continuous; dark-figure zero-change proof is numeric.

measurements.mask_method: Trace anchors/labels; trace figure boxes plus remeasured conservative full wing/cape/base-rim envelope (trace box retained separately); 96-vertex topology space polygons through fitted homography; inter-space edge corridors 4px; panels include keyline. Per-frame details in layout-measurements.json.

heal_example.effectAfter: If King Arthur has 4 or less health but is not defeated, set his health to 8.

limitations.note: Under-base tags may cover part of their occupied space; zero-space acceptance applies to the plate choice masks. No runtime/editor validation is claimed.
Crowded figures / seam clearance require lateral offsets for some tags; 1su leaders preserve attribution.
720p UI100 is not a required output; cap10su at device .75 would be 7.5px.
